tasks.task: Build or fix one React or Vue component

items.when: When there is a screen design and a full spec is needed so nothing is guessed in the build
When you write the component with a props table, every state, keyboard use and tests
When an existing component shows a blank box while loading, empty or failed
When a component changed, to find the states and variants still missing
When it works but feels unfinished, for notes on motion, feel and small details

tasks.task: Build a new page on a business's existing website

items.when: Before any code, to measure the live site's colours, fonts, buttons and layout into a file
When copy, colours and fonts are known and the client should compare three on-brand designs
When the page must look like part of the site they have, not a fresh template
When the page is built, to check fonts, colours, buttons, header and footer against the live site
Before handover, to check contrast, spacing, hierarchy and the phone view

tasks.task: Build a fast one-file landing page in HTML and CSS

items.when: Before building, to compare three designs made from the client's copy and colours
When a founder needs a landing, waitlist or event page this week on a free static host
When copy and layout are already checked and need turning into plain HTML with a working form
When the sign-up form needs its fields, error messages and spam protection planned
When the page looks machine-made, to score it and rank what to change
When the page asks visitors to think, to make the one next step obvious

tasks.task: Fix a page that breaks on phones

items.when: When text overflows, buttons overlap, a table scrolls sideways or the menu will not open
When parts of the page jump as it loads and you have the layout shift report
After the fix, to check spacing, tap sizes and hierarchy on the small view
When the client wants screenshots and pass or fail results as proof

tasks.task: Fix accessibility problems in a page or component

items.when: Before fixing, to get the problems on a page or in code ranked against WCAG 2.2
When you need a test plan for keyboard and screen reader use, not only a code scan
When you fix what code can fix: headings, labels, keyboard access, focus and contrast
When a part is beyond repair and must be rebuilt accessible from the start
When colour pairs fail and you need the closest passing shade for light and dark themes

tasks.task: Find why a page is slow and what to fix first

items.when: When you have speed test results and must explain them plainly and rank the fixes
When the client pastes a PageSpeed report and wants the fixes in ordered batches
When the main image is the slow part and must be set to load first
When the layout shift score fails and each shifting element needs its cause fixed
When the fix must land as a pull request with before and after timings
When the page is fast again and a build check should stop it slowing down later

tasks.task: Write an image and font loading plan

items.when: When the site's images and video need formats, responsive sizes and a hosting plan
When heavy images must become smaller files that look the same
Before the plan, to see which images and fonts cost the most load time

tasks.task: Plan a speed clean-up for a WordPress or Shopify site

items.when: Before touching plugins or apps, to find what the speed tests really blame
When the site is WordPress and plugins, caching, database and images all need ranking
When the site is Shopify and app scripts, styles and fonts block the first paint

tasks.task: Build, fix or review a small browser extension

items.when: When a team repeats the same clicks on sites they own and wants a small extension
Before publishing, after a store rejection, or when asked if it is safe to install
When someone else wrote the add-on and you want a read-only safety review first
When the extension needs a README and set-up guide that match what the code does
When the guide is written, to follow each install step and mark it working or broken

tasks.task: Move an old component to hooks or the Composition API

items.when: When the old component has no tests and needs a safety net before it changes
When a class or Options API component must move to modern style with the same behaviour
When React class components still use the old lifecycle methods
When the app is moving to React 19 and roots, refs and default props must change

tasks.task: Write component and browser tests for part of a UI

items.when: Before writing tests, to list every page and part with what is tested and what is not
When React components and user tasks lack tests
When the app is Vue and components and stores need behaviour and failure tests
When a whole user journey should be tested in a real browser
When browser tests exist but fail at random, to check them for bad habits
When nobody dares touch a component, to list the cases and add tests one small step at a time

tasks.task: Turn a design into a build plan and component brief

items.when: When a whole front end needs a component list, a speed and accessibility plan and an order
When one part of the design needs a spec complete enough to build without questions
When the design files are shared and variants, states and tokens must all be written
When a finished design needs layout, breakpoints and edge cases specified
When the brief is drafted, to find the states nobody designed

tasks.task: Build a sign-up or contact form that works

items.when: Before code, to settle fields, error messages and spam protection
When you write the form with every state: empty, invalid, sending, failed and sent
When labels, hints and error lines need to be short and kind
When people give up halfway and the form needs fewer fields and a test script

tasks.task: Put a static page live with a hosting config

items.when: When the page should go live on Netlify as a preview or production deploy
When the client's domain is on Cloudflare and the page should be served from there
After the deploy, to prove the live page is the version you meant to ship

tasks.task: Ship a UI change through a pull request

items.when: When a page, component or fix is requested and must go from brief to merged
When an AI coding tool will write the change and needs a test list and small steps
When the branch is ready and reviewers need what changed, why and what to look at
When each pull request should get a risk rating and ranked findings before a person reviews

tasks.task: Run the monthly speed and accessibility check

items.when: Once a month on the same pages, and after a redesign, new theme, app or tracking tag
When the client wants a regular wider check of the site, not only speed and access
Each quarter, to rank the gaps and confirm last quarter's fixes held

tasks.task: Build a dashboard, table or chart view

items.when: Before building, to list what the screen shows when empty, loading, failed or with no results
When filters, tables and modals must be reusable parts with every state handled
When the view needs a chart with hover and zoom that can be embedded in a page
When the client should see a quick working dashboard from their data before the real build

tasks.task: Set up design tokens and tidy a component library

items.when: When the live site is the only source of truth for colours, fonts and spacing
When brand colours and fonts must become tokens with responsive sizes
When components hold hardcoded values and uneven names that need finding
Before the tokens are agreed, to check every text and background pair

tasks.task: Add or fix animation and small interactions

items.when: When the page needs timed, staggered or SVG motion written in code
When an animation stutters and each slow spot needs a small fix
When a change adds motion, to get a table of fixes and an approve or block call
When motion must respect people who ask their device for less of it

tasks.task: Add meta tags, structured data and tracking to a page

items.when: When a page needs its title, description, headings and image text fixed
When the page type calls for checked structured data ready to paste
When events must be named and planned before any tag is added

tasks.task: Fix a component or page that renders wrong

items.when: When the console shows an error or stack trace and you need the cause
When the fix must come with the cause proven, a test and a pull request
When the bug is a missing state and the component needs that state built
When the client wants before and after screenshots as proof of the fix

tasks.task: Prepare a UI for more than one language

items.when: When text is hardcoded and needs locale files and right-to-left support planned
When strings are translated, to check meaning and that longer words still fit

tasks.task: Review a UI for finish before release

items.when: When you need contrast, spacing, hierarchy and the phone view checked with fixes
When the UI looks templated, to score it and rank what gives it away
When details such as focus rings, transitions and feedback need a final pass
When it looks fine but people may still get lost, to walk it for likely usability problems

always.when: At the end of any coding job, to write what changed, why and the proof that it works

helpers.when: When there is no design and the page or component needs one before it is built
When a landing page needs its headline, sections and call to action written
When the client needs a full audit and an accessibility statement, not code fixes
When the UI needs an endpoint, a form handler or data it cannot get yet
When the page must rank and needs more than tidy tags and markup
When the change needs testing across browsers, devices and user journeys

gaps: No library item builds or fixes a Manifest V3 browser extension, or plans a move from Manifest V2
No library item fixes a responsive layout from a screenshot of a page that breaks on phones
No library item moves a Vue Options API component to the Composition API
No library item wires a static form to a form service such as Formspree, Netlify Forms or Basin
No library item writes a static host config: redirects, headers and cache rules
No library item cuts JavaScript bundle size or finds unused code and heavy third-party scripts
No library item plans web font loading: subsets, preload and fallback fonts
No library item runs visual regression tests that compare screenshots before and after a change
No library item reads Core Web Vitals field data apart from lab data; only the kit does
No library item covers client-side state and data fetching for React or Vue web apps
No library item writes Svelte or Angular components
